purpose: Defines which actors execute doc-link processing, their responsibilities and write permissions, the logical script operations, Skill-script connection rules, and where managed state and temp files are stored.
summary: Actor table: caller or project AI, Skill, deterministic scripts, information-generation AI, search AI, and user, with permissions and prohibitions
Logical script operations with inputs, results, side effects, and failure promises
Skill-script connection rules: inherited execution, no self-reported stage success, guards in scripts
Information-generation AI context restriction: only document content and the public limit, never the internal upper limit
Impact notification is enumerated mechanically by scripts, with no AI judgment on fix necessity
Partial failure of DLID assignment: written DLIDs are kept and failures reported per document
All files stay inside the project; temp files go under .temp/doc-link/<skill>/
Managed state in .doc-link/ as JSON tracked by git, split per document ID and per ToC key
Deterministic byte output and no rewrite of unchanged files
tasks: Designing script operations and Skill boundaries
Designing prompts for the information-generation AI
Deciding where managed state or temp files are stored
Handling merge conflicts in managed state files
title: DES-002 実行主体と処理責務
